episodes.synopsis: As the Dark Rebel Army closes in, the Kingdom of Meta-llicana falls to its knees. Its only hope lies in awakening a powerful but evil sorcerer.
episodes.title: The Arrival

episodes.synopsis: Left with no other option, Yoko revives Dark Schneider once again when a terrifying multiheaded monster attacks the Kingdom of Meta-llicana.
episodes.title: Rampage

episodes.synopsis: The first of four seals that contain the God of Destruction breaks. As a crisis looms in sight, Yoko grapples with conflicting emotions.
episodes.title: Abduction

episodes.synopsis: Sheila and Dark Schneider set out to free Yoko, whose captor threatens to torment her unless she discloses how she unseals the powerful wizard.
episodes.title: Invasion

episodes.synopsis: The demon god Efreet unleashes deadly flames, and Dark Schneider must find a way out in order to save Yoko.
episodes.title: Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Outraged by Dark Schneider's success, Kall-Su orders Arshes Nei, a half-dark elf, to put an end to the reincarnated wizard before he grows too strong.
episodes.title: Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Arshes Nei sends sorcerer Kai Harn to defeat Dark Schneider, who uses High Ancient Magic to try to turn him into a stone statue.
episodes.title: The Demon Beast

episodes.synopsis: Lucien reunites with Yoko in the forest, but they are soon attacked by a Werewolf soldier working for Count Di-amon, a powerful vampire.
episodes.title: The Progenitor

episodes.synopsis: While Dark Schneider struggles to break free from captivity, Yoko, Kai Harn and Sean Ari fend for themselves against Di-amon.
episodes.title: Blue Nail

episodes.synopsis: The remaining members of the Divine Kings gather and vow to eliminate Dark Schneider. Abigail tests Arshes Nei's loyalty to their mission.
episodes.title: The Goddess of Thunder

episodes.synopsis: Dark Schneider and Arshes Nei reunite for the first time since his reincarnation. Baba, an old woman with prophetic powers, has an alarming vision.
episodes.title: Prophecy

episodes.synopsis: Arshes Nei unleashes a surprise attack on the castle, getting the upper hand in her battle against a disarmed adversary.
episodes.title: Life or Death

episodes.synopsis: Nearly equal in strength, two opponents ratchet up the rapidly escalating fight. Meanwhile, the warriors struggle with their emotions.
episodes.title: Wavering

episodes.synopsis: After Dark Schneider's sacrifice, his allies grieve a major loss. Meanwhile, Kall-Su and Abigail’s Army of Decay continue to wreak havoc.
episodes.title: Moved to Tears

episodes.synopsis: Arshes and Gara face-off against Lynch but realize they are no match against the ruthless creature. Abigail receives word of Dark Schneider’s return.
episodes.title: Triumphant Return

episodes.synopsis: With his newfound strength, Dark Schneider attempts to face Vivian — a Devil Mace-wielding cyclops fueled by Anthrasax’s immense power — all on his own.
episodes.title: Incantation

episodes.synopsis: Lich reaches Meta-llicana, seeking vengeance against Dark Schneider. The two face off but Arshes notices that something is off.
episodes.title: Ring

episodes.synopsis: Yoko fearlessly stands up against Abigail. Facing Lich alone, Gara’s only chance of survival is to use the full potential of the Murasame Blade.
episodes.title: Secrets of the Sword

episodes.synopsis: Sensing danger, Arshes heads to Meta-llicana Castle and stops Abigail in his tracks when he sets out to collect the last seal.
episodes.title: Empress of Thunder

episodes.synopsis: After learning the secret of the final seal, Dark Schneider agrees to protect Sheila. Abigail reveals his true self and turns the tables on Arshes Nei.
episodes.title: Tyranny

episodes.synopsis: Dark Schneider puts up a good fight against the evolved Abigail, but things take a turn for the worst when the dark wizard’s plan backfires.
episodes.title: Fierce Battle

episodes.synopsis: The castle walls crumble with the full force of Dark Schneider’s Helloween spell, but Abigail seems unaffected. Arshes swoops in to assist her lover.
episodes.title: Conclusion

episodes.synopsis: Arshes and Gara stand up to Abigail but are in no condition to fight. Abigail preys on Dark Schneider’s ultimate weakness.
episodes.title: Annihilation

episodes.synopsis: As Abigail taunts Dark Schneider for possessing a human heart, fire spirits come to the rescue and assist the wizard in one final battle.
episodes.title: End
